The MCQ 5 and 9 options and stem print the quotation marks as broken glyphs in the PDF (font encoding, e.g. '—Lubb||'); they are given as “Lubb”, “Dubb”, “lub-dubb” — a rendering fix, not a wording change. No wording errors in the printed questions.
